sign_flip_placebo.reading: the placebo does not pay: -0.001777/month vs the unconditioned book at NW lag-2 t -0.9342 over 359 blocks. §5 fires on a placebo that pays (positive AND |t| >= 2.0); a placebo indistinguishable from 0 is what the book needs and is not by itself evidence FOR the book.

momentum_orthogonalisation.construction: v0's own `momentum_overhang_rows` and `fama_macbeth_orthogonalisation`, unchanged. The overhang on the right-hand side is the same series the book traded, because `book_c_event_sign_v1` builds it by calling v0's `book_c_overhang`.

fama_macbeth.units: every slope is the next month's return per ONE cross-sectional sd of the regressor, and every residual is re-standardised so the four legs share that ruler

momentum_orthogonalisation.why: raw 12-1 momentum carries t 0.1525 on the book's own rows, below the |t| >= 2.0 line, BEFORE overhang enters (after: t 0.1174). Grinblatt-Han's subsumption claim is untestable here -- nothing to subsume -- so this is NOT a pass of that test. The §5 clause's purpose, 'it was momentum in costume', is answered: momentum earns nothing on these rows, so the book's excess is not momentum's, and the FAILED_VARIANT clause does not fire. Overhang's own residual payoff carries t 0.8595.
